NightSoundscape - licences and provenance
Prepared October 14, 2026 for the Jewelry-store-vr-demo project; revised October 15, 2026 after review (see REVISION
at the end). Status: fetched/generated, not yet wired; unverified in Unity and not auditioned.

Every shipped audio file is either (A) original project content or (B/C) a processed copy of a CC0 recording, except
DogBarkDistant_01..03.wav, which are treated as CC BY 3.0 with attribution (see B3).
No file is NonCommercial, NoDerivatives, editorial-only or of unknown licence. No real voices, brands or logos are
contained in the sound files. Per-file SHA256, cut points, levels and the full processing chain are in sources.json.

Licence verification note: freesound.org could not be opened from the preparation environment (neither from the
container nor from the web reader). The CC0 status of each Freesound recording below is therefore taken from the
per-asset licence metadata of the GitHub mirror that supplied the file (named for each group), and from a second,
independent repository where one is listed. Please open the original Freesound pages once before a public release.

CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
CC0 requires no attribution; the CC0 credits below are given voluntarily. The Kinoton recording (B3) is used under
CC BY 3.0 and its attribution is REQUIRED wherever the project credits its assets (in-app credits, ASSET_REGISTER).

====================================================================================================================
A. ORIGINAL PROJECT CONTENT (synthesized; project-owned)
====================================================================================================================
Created for the Jewelry-store-vr-demo project on October 14, 2026 by Claude (Anthropic) with numpy/scipy/ffmpeg.
Licence: owned by the project, no third-party restrictions; may be used, modified and redistributed with the project.
No sampled recordings are contained in these files (except the recorded footstep layer of FootstepGlass_0x, see B4).
Scripts: Generator/make_alarm.py, make_room.py, make_radio.py (+ speech_babble.py), make_foley.py, make_sirens.py
(fixed seeds).

  AlarmBell_Close_Loop.wav, AlarmBell_Street_Loop.ogg, AlarmBell_Interior_Loop.wav
      Physical modal model of a trembler gong bell. Only numbers (mode frequency ratios and relative levels) were
      measured from "fire alarm bell" by msx2plus (https://freesound.org/s/678345/, CC0 per
      https://github.com/Dhruv-Mishra/VoxelGame/blob/1d0730642b44cd24182980a8da32b93b40dfc8ff/assets/sfx/CREDITS.txt,
      file assets/sfx/alarm_loop.mp3, sha256 2e3a37454e07172dc5acbb3ceb8eabf8c3918ab5150a23edcf5a9422295b5d86);
      none of that recording's audio is in the pack.
  HVACVent_Loop.wav, FluorescentBuzz_Loop.wav, FridgeCompressor_Loop.wav
  PoliceCarRadio_Loop.ogg, RadioChatter_01..05.wav, RadioSquelch_01..03.wav, RadioBeep_01..03.wav
      Speech-like babble from a source-filter (formant) synthesizer written for this pack (Generator/speech_babble.py):
      random syllables, no words, no real person's voice, no dispatcher content. RadioChatter_01..05 and
      PoliceCarRadio_Loop were rebuilt on October 15, 2026; RadioSquelch and RadioBeep are unchanged.
      Beeps are generic sine tones, not any radio manufacturer's tone set.
  GlassShardsTinkle_01..04.wav, GlassCrunch_01..04.wav
  EvidenceMarkerPlace_01..03.wav, ConePlace_01..03.wav
  TapeUnroll_01..02.wav, TapeStretchSnap_01..02.wav, BarrierTapeFlutter_Loop.wav
  CameraShutterDSLR_01..02.wav, FlashlightClick_01..02.wav, FlashlightClickHalf_01.wav
  KeysJingle_01..03.wav, ZipperOpen_01..02.wav, ZipperClose_01.wav
  (glass layers of) FootstepGlass_01..05.wav

====================================================================================================================
B. CC0 FIELD RECORDINGS FROM FREESOUND, VIA GITHUB MIRRORS
====================================================================================================================
Changes made for this pack (all files in B): decoded from the mirror's lossy file (AAC/MP3/Opus/Vorbis), trimmed,
high-pass filtered, edge fades, mono fold-down for 3D one-shots, seamless loop crossfades for loops, loudness/peak
normalisation, re-encoded as 16-bit PCM WAV or Ogg Vorbis. Further changes are noted per item.

B1. Mirror: timmywheels/atmospherics  https://github.com/timmywheels/atmospherics
    commit 743012245d9d567d9397295758fb87f069370a0d (repository code MIT; the per-sound list design/sounds/SOURCES.md
    states "Every recording is public domain or CC0" and lists each source with licence CC0).
    - NightCity_Loop.ogg  <- Atmospherics/Sounds/cityNight.m4a
        "Downtown LA, Little Tokyo, late night semi distant traffic.wav" by janbezouska
        https://freesound.org/s/330427/  - CC0 1.0 (also listed CC0 by Aarymanv/hillbomb-sf ASSET_LICENSES.md)
    - NightCityDistant_Loop.ogg  <- Atmospherics/Sounds/cityHum.m4a
        "Distant city evening traffic, 5th floor balcony" by risto_alcinov
        https://freesound.org/s/371250/  - CC0 1.0 (also listed CC0, "verified", by scenesua/Lullaby-scene)
    - StreetWind_Loop.ogg  <- Atmospherics/Sounds/wind.m4a
        wind recording by Fission9  https://freesound.org/s/521736/  - CC0 1.0
    - WindWhistleGap_Loop.ogg  <- Atmospherics/Sounds/howl.m4a
        wind howling at a window, by swiftoid  https://freesound.org/s/117610/  - CC0 1.0

B2. Mirror: Aarymanv/hillbomb-sf  https://github.com/Aarymanv/hillbomb-sf
    commit 937d362243a56fd7aed001e36dc5051e1959a04d (public/assets/ASSET_LICENSES.md: "All audio files are processed
    derivatives ... of recordings released under CC0 1.0 / public domain ... Freesound.org (only sounds whose page
    states Creative Commons 0)"; per-file licence "CC0 1.0" in dev/audio.pipeline/fragments/*.json).
    - LightRainStreet_Loop.ogg  <- public/assets/audio/amb/rain_light.mp3
        "Light rain on street.wav" by BonnyOrbit  https://freesound.org/s/380651/  - CC0 1.0
        (also listed CC0 by openOMSI-org/openOMSI tools/ambience/CREDITS.md)
    - SirenDistantCity_03.wav  <- public/assets/audio/amb/distant_siren.mp3
        "siren police north american distant city echo changes behind buildings natural nice +bassy skyline lowcut to
        taste.flac" by kyles  https://freesound.org/s/635741/  - CC0 1.0
    - SirenWailPassDistant_01.wav, SirenWailYelpPass_02.wav  <- public/assets/audio/loops/siren_wail.mp3, siren_yelp.mp3
        "Whelen Wail.wav" and "Whelen Yelp.wav" by Jefflix  https://freesound.org/s/157867/ , https://freesound.org/s/157866/
        - CC0 1.0. (The original titles name the siren's maker; the sound is a generic electronic police siren and
        the pack's file names carry no brand.) Additional change: re-spatialised by Generator/make_sirens.py
        (moving source with Doppler delay, distance attenuation, air absorption, occlusion, synthetic street reverb).
    - DogBarkDistant_04.wav  <- public/assets/audio/amb/dog_bark.mp3
        "Dogs Barking in Distance_Rural.wav" by rvandemark  https://freesound.org/s/581478/  - CC0 1.0
    - CarPassWet_01.wav  <- public/assets/audio/sfx/passby_wet_1.mp3
        "Passing Car (Wet road)" by Breviceps  https://freesound.org/s/462862/  - CC0 1.0
    - CarPass_03.wav  <- public/assets/audio/sfx/passby_2.mp3
        "Car by slow Civic and Volvo DonFX.wav" by Donmann  https://freesound.org/s/237338/  - CC0 1.0
    - FootstepHard_01..06.wav  <- public/assets/audio/sfx/foot_concrete_1..6.mp3
        "Footsteps on concrete" by florianreichelt  https://freesound.org/s/459964/  - CC0 1.0
    B4. FootstepGlass_01..05.wav = foot_concrete_1..5 above (CC0) mixed with original synthesized glass layers (A).
        Remixed October 15, 2026 (glass layers 8 dB lower, spikes soft-limited, so the step body leads).

B3. Mirror: scenesua/Lullaby-scene  https://github.com/scenesua/Lullaby-scene
    commit 74fce68956b5d03a2582a4d76798dfc8b77ca7ed (app/src/main/assets/ambience/manifest/external_licenses.json:
    per asset "license": "CC0-1.0", "license_status": "verified", source page, sha256 of the shipped file - the
    hashes of the files used here match). The repository has no top-level licence; only the CC0 recordings are used.
    - SirenDistantPass_04.wav  <- hood_journey/events/hood_siren_event_001.ogg
        "Police Siren" by TitanKaempfer  https://freesound.org/s/746302/  - CC0 1.0
    - DogBarkDistant_01..03.wav  <- hood_journey/events/hood_dog_event_001.ogg
        Title: "Dog Barking in Neighborhood"   Author: Kinoton   Source: https://freesound.org/s/516904/
        LICENCE USED HERE: CC BY 3.0  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/  (attribution required)
        Why: the licence evidence conflicts and the Freesound page could not be opened. CC0 per this mirror's
        external_licenses.json (license "CC0-1.0", license_status "verified") and per rustemd02/URMAN
        game/assets/audio/act1/sound_mood/credits.json ("Creative Commons 0 (CC0 1.0)"); CC BY 3.0 per
        NickJVaccaro/valleyofshadow-site src/assets/data/asset-credits.json ("license": "CC BY 3.0",
        "attributionRequired": "y"; that list marks CC0 and CC BY items separately). Until the Freesound page is checked,
        the clips are treated under the stricter licence, CC BY 3.0, which also satisfies CC0.
        Changes: trimmed (cuts 0.50-1.45 s, 1.98-3.50 s, 0.45-9.20 s), filtered (40 Hz high-pass), normalised
        (-3 dBFS peak), edge fades, mono 16-bit WAV.
        REQUIRED ATTRIBUTION (in-app credits and Docs/ASSET_REGISTER.md):
        "Dog Barking in Neighborhood" by Kinoton (https://freesound.org/s/516904/), licensed CC BY 3.0
        (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/); trimmed, filtered and normalised.
        If attribution cannot be shown, drop these three files and use DogBarkDistant_04.wav (rvandemark, CC0).
    - CarDoorOpen_01.wav, CarDoorSlam_01.wav  <- hood_journey/events/hood_car_door_event_001.ogg
        "Opening and Closing car door in parkade" by SduggySounds  https://freesound.org/s/721619/  - CC0 1.0
    - CarPass_02.wav  <- hood_journey/events/hood_car_pass_event_001.ogg
        "Car passing by" by colorsCrimsonTears  https://freesound.org/s/538687/  - CC0 1.0
    - HVACRoomTone_Loop.ogg  <- submarine_journey/continuous/submarine_journey_arrival_001.ogg
        "G45-22 Submarine Air Conditioner" by craigsmith  https://freesound.org/s/438724/  - CC0 1.0

B5. Mirror: Jxstrr0/350Chev  https://github.com/Jxstrr0/350Chev
    commit b80c73b490962d4de5d47cf49e99e68a21c968dc, file sounds/v8x54_idle.mp3
    (sha256 e2fe4ed9baaef8752b19f0963041825a46b71eb3f5e2a5704db7b57108101610). Licence evidence: sounds/CREDITS.md lists
    the file as "Ford F350 5.4 V8 startup and idle | Therancher01 | CC0 1.0 | Freesound 610772", records the raw
    Freesound page licence field read on 2026-10-10 ("Creative Commons 0"), and states that each derived .mp3 keeps the
    licence of its source ("CC0 / public-domain sources stay CC0"). Verbatim excerpt: Licenses/Jxstrr0_350Chev_sounds_CREDITS_excerpt.txt.
    Upstream changes (350Chev): Freesound HQ preview, 5-28 s window time-warped to a steady 999 rpm, cut to whole engine
    cycles, looped, 28 Hz high-pass, loudness-normalised, mono 96 kbps MP3.
    - PoliceCarIdle_Loop.wav  <- "Ford F350 5.4 V8 startup and idle" by Therancher01  https://freesound.org/s/610772/
        - CC0 1.0. Changes here: decoded, DC removed, 45 Hz 4th-order high-pass, the 3.60 s loop tiled 4x through a
        periodic time warp (+-0.6 % idle-speed hunting) with a +-0.7 dB level drift, -20 LUFS, 16-bit WAV (14.4 s).
        (Replaces the October 14 loop made from "car idle" by seth-m, freesound 269771, CC0, which was almost all
        sub-bass; that recording is no longer shipped.)

C. KENNEY RPG AUDIO 1.0 (CC0)
====================================================================================================================
Created/distributed by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio , creation date 17-03-2014.
Licence: Creative Commons Zero, CC0 (author notice kept in Licenses/Kenney_RPG_Audio_License.txt).
Fetched from the mirror https://github.com/series-ai/jam-ready-assets commit bdce326b2d7eee85524c08c751faf4804d453f3d
(kenney-rpg-audio/audio/Audio/*.ogg, Git LFS objects from media.githubusercontent.com, sha256 checked against the
LFS pointers). Changes: decoded, mono, 40 Hz high-pass, fades, -3 dBFS peak, 16-bit WAV.
    DoorCreak_01..03.wav <- creak1.ogg, creak2.ogg, creak3.ogg
    DoorOpen_01..02.wav  <- doorOpen_1.ogg, doorOpen_2.ogg
    DoorClose_01..02.wav <- doorClose_1.ogg, doorClose_4.ogg

====================================================================================================================
REVISION October 15, 2026 (after an independent review)
====================================================================================================================
- PoliceCarIdle_Loop.wav: new source (B5, Therancher01, CC0) instead of seth-m "car idle" (82 % of its energy below
  40 Hz, inaudible on Quest 2 speakers).
- RadioChatter_01..05.wav, PoliceCarRadio_Loop.ogg: regenerated with Generator/speech_babble.py (original, A).
- FootstepGlass_01..05.wav: remixed (B4 + A).
- DogBarkDistant_01..03.wav: licence recorded as CC BY 3.0 with required attribution (B3).
- All other files unchanged (same bytes as October 14).
